title: carthamus tenuis
intro: Carthamus tenuis, commonly known as False Safflower, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Carthamus tenuis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
